messages:
Priya: Heads up — final-round SRE interview on Thu 3pm PT needs panel tweak. Sam is OOO that day, can someone cover one slot?
Samir: I can pick up a 3:00–3:30 chunk if we compress the order a bit.
Elena: I can take the first 15m (3:00–3:15) and hand off to Samir.
Priya: Thanks @Samir @Elena — appreciate it. Who wants debrief lead + scribe? We need someone to own score normalization.
Jordan: I can scribe and own normalization. Quick preference: do we use the usual 40/30/30 weights (system design/infra leadership/collab)?
Priya: Yes, stick to 40/30/30 unless Shane asked for a different split — he didn’t.
Maya: Quick Q — candidate asked to avoid shared whiteboards, prefers to draw on paper. Is that ok?
Priya: Totally fine. We'll note that they declined a shared board; let them present from their camera.
Samir: Also small logistics: can we shift candidate 10m earlier to 2:50 to make the handoff smoother?
Elena: Works for me.
Jordan: Works for me.
Maya: Works for me.
Priya: Great — I’ll update calendar if no objections.
Samir: One more ask — Jordan, can you paste the rubric anchors into the invite so panel has them top-of-invite? Little cheat-sheet.
Jordan: Yep, will add brief bullets:
- System design (40%) — architecture, tradeoffs, scalability
- Infra leadership (30%) — incident handling, prioritization
- Collaboration (30%) — communication, mentorship
Priya: Perfect. @interview-bot can you remind panel to submit debriefs within 24h? Also enable transcript capture for internal notes.
interview-bot: Reminder: submit debrief within 24 hours of interview. Transcript capture is enabled for internal notes. Candidate consent: none recorded. Link: https://intranet.reed.example/debriefs/tx123
Priya: Thanks. Final check — does anyone need prep materials or candidate packet posted to the calendar before EOD?
Maya: I’ll upload the candidate resume + takehome link to the invite in 15m.
Elena: I’ll add a short note about the no-whiteboard request so the panel knows.
Priya: Awesome — saved my afternoon. Thanks all :thumbsup
thread: final-round SRE scheduling and rubric anchor
